note: Dimensions the fleet profile does not provide. Every entry is provisional and is a question for the mechanical designer (see CAD_IMPORT.md checklist). Edit here, not in gen_provisional.py.

tessellation._note: Render quality only; not a design question.

edge_chamfer.question: Outer shell chamfer width (m). Designer: bumper/shell edge treatment?

corner_chamfer.question: Vertical corner chamfer at the docking ends (m).

top_plate_thickness.question: Thickness of the top cover plate over the wheel wells (m).

wheel_well_inset.question: How far the body is cut back from its side wall inside each wheel well (m). Real wheel-to-body clearance?

wheel_well_margin.question: Clearance between wheel radius and the well edge along x (m).

dock_module_depth.question: Depth of the docking end block behind the face plane (m).

hub_radius_frac.question: Hub radius as fraction of wheel radius. Wheel model?

end_plate_radius_frac.question: Roller end-plate radius as fraction of roller-circle radius.

roller_fill.question: Roller diameter as fraction of the max that fits between neighbours (rollers must not touch).

roller_taper.question: Barrel profile: r(t)=r0*sqrt(1-taper*(2t/L)^2). Real roller profile?

roller_angle.question: Roller axis angle to the wheel axis; the profile only says 45deg. Confirm.

pocket_depth.question: Depth of the docking pocket behind the face plane (m). Hook and pin geometry?

pocket_half_height.question: Half height of the pocket opening (m).

pocket_side_margin.question: Lateral margin between swung-out hook and pocket wall (m).

hook_arm_length.question: Pivot to hook tip (m). Hook geometry?

hook_level_dz.question: z stagger of the two hooks about the face centre (m): hook A sits +dz, hook B -dz so identical faces mate. Designer: confirm the hermaphroditic stagger or give the real coupler.

hook_prong_reach.question: Prong reach across the arm toward the centreline (m).

hook_pivot_inset.question: Pivot sits this far in front of the pocket back wall (m).

hook_open_angle.question: Swing-out angle for the open state (rad). Hook travel?

engage_clearance.question: Clearance between prong/arm and the caught pin (m).

guide_flare_deg.question: Funnel flare angle of the mouth chamfer (deg). Profile gives acceptance angle only.

guide_chamfer_max_frac_of_rail.question: Chamfer width never exceeds this fraction of the top rail height.

tag_recess.question: Tag plate stands this far off the pocket back wall (m).

marker_size.question: Placeholder plate for left/right faces which are not modelled (m).

id_base.question: Tag ids per role: front=+0, rear=+1, left=+2, right=+3, top=+4. Fleet-wide id allocation?

id_offset_second_cargo.question: cargo_2 adds this to every cargo tag id.

top_tag_offset_xy.question: Top tag centre (x,y) in base. Cargo tag is covered by payload.

top_tag_standoff.question: Plate sits this far above the surface (m).

mast_added_mass_footprint.question: x,y footprint of the box used to place the 2 kg added mass.

stereo_bar_below_mast_top.question: Bar centre this far below the mast top (m).

puck_base_frac.question: Fraction of puck height that is the static base.

column_x.question: Lift column x on the body (m). Lift mechanism?

column_height_above_top.question: Column height above the body top (m).

carriage_standoff.question: Clearance (m) between the closed hook tips and the carriage plate: the plate sits at face + hook protrusion + this. Lift mechanism layout?

carriage_low_bottom_above_ground.question: Plate bottom height above ground at lift = 0 (m).

fork_plate_length.question: Fork plate reach beyond the carriage plate (m).

fork_plate_margin.question: Fork plate extends beyond the open fingers by this (m).

finger_start_from_plate.question: Finger starts this far out from the carriage plate (m).

gripper_min_opening.question: Smallest clear gap between closed fingers (m).

camera_dz_above_plate_bottom.question: Front camera height on the carriage plate (m).

tof_offset_y.question: ToF y offset from camera on the plate (m).

deck_height_reference.question: Profile deck_height 0.14: taken as the deck top above the GROUND, not above the body underside. Confirm.

front_sensor_x.question: x of front camera/ToF on lifter/cargo top edge.

foot_size.question: Contact patch (foot) size for box_long / tray_wide (m).

base_patch_frac.question: box_small contact patch as fraction of footprint.

lifter_added_box.question: Box (x,y,z) standing for the 2 kg of lift hardware, centred over the carriage/column.

cargo_added_box_z.question: Deck plate thickness used for the mass model (m).

scout_added_box_height.question: Height of the added mass box on the mast (m).

arm_proxy_box.question: Box used for the optional arm-proxy inertia (m).
